unit_label: BRBL::MOD_C::U17: Distinguish prima-facie admissibility from conclusive proof and officer-production exceptions

payload.title: Admissible evidence still has to support the claim
payload.core_explanation_md:
A compliant certified entry is received under the stated framework as prima-facie evidence to the extent the original entry would be admissible. It is not an automatic judgment that every pleaded liability exists. The source specifically warns against treating account entries alone as sufficient proof of every disputed payment or transaction. Reconcile the contract, disbursement, admissions and other relevant evidence.

The1891 officer-production protection also has a scope: where the bank is not a party, the described books/witness protection is subject to a court or Judge order for special cause. It should not be rewritten as an absolute refusal to respond to every lawful evidence request.

self_check.prompt_text: Does prima facie mean impossible to dispute?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Admissibility and the ultimate proof of liability are distinct.

payload.stem_md: A certified statement is treated as conclusive proof of every disputed contractual allegation. Which distinction corrects that claim?

options.text_md: Prima-facie entry evidence and final liability are different determinations
options.explanation_md: The source preserves the need for relevant substantive proof.
The framework permits properly certified entries.

options.text_md: A bank logo establishes every allegation
options.explanation_md: Branding does not establish a legal claim.

options.text_md: The judge must ignore all other evidence
options.explanation_md: The case still requires evaluation of the relevant record.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The source preserves the need for relevant substantive proof.

payload.stem_md: A non-party bank invokes the officer-production protection despite an actual special-cause order. What must be checked?

options.text_md: The bank may disregard every order automatically
options.explanation_md: The protection contains an express exception.

options.text_md: Every non-party bank must send all records publicly
options.explanation_md: The request scope and safeguards still matter.

options.text_md: The order, its special-cause basis and the applicable statutory scope
options.explanation_md: The exception prevents an absolute-refusal interpretation.

options.text_md: Only whether the customer changed address
options.explanation_md: Address alone does not decide the evidentiary order.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The exception prevents an absolute-refusal interpretation.
